metadata.title: U.S. Probate Records for Genealogy  |  Midwest Genealogy Center
metadata.author: Mid-Continent Public Library
metadata.shortDescription:
Probate records can help genealogists scale that brick wall between generations and add information about their family. If your ancestor had assets, they probably had probate papers. This class follows the estate from the documents to the final settlement. It also covers items such as dower rights. It does not offer legal advice. 

This program was created for an adult audience. 

Please be sure to like and share! Visit our website to register for upcoming in-person and virtual Genealogy programming events! https://www.mymcpl.org/genealogy 

Check more Genealogy virtual programming videos on our playlist here: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLnm7vznxHH_cDXKlVbtZtZ3et2etxoLne
